WITH sales_returns AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk,
        wr.wr_reason_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_fee,
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit
    FROM web_returns AS wr
    JOIN web_sales AS ws
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    JOIN date_dim AS d
      ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
     AND d.d_year = 1998
    JOIN web_page AS wp
      ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
      AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
),
addr_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        sr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        sr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        sr.wr_reason_sk,
        sr.wr_refunded_cash,
        sr.wr_fee,
        sr.ws_quantity,
        sr.ws_sales_price
    FROM sales_returns AS sr
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = sr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_country = 'United States'
      AND (
          (ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND sr.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND sr.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
       OR (ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND sr.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      )
),
demo1 AS (
    SELECT cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_sk, cd2.cd_demo_sk AS cd2_sk
    FROM customer_demographics AS cd1
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
demo2 AS (
    SELECT cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_sk, cd2.cd_demo_sk AS cd2_sk
    FROM customer_demographics AS cd1
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
),
demo3 AS (
    SELECT cd1.cd_demo_sk AS cd1_sk, cd2.cd_demo_sk AS cd2_sk
    FROM customer_demographics AS cd1
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
      ON cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
     AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT af.wr_reason_sk, af.ws_quantity, af.wr_refunded_cash, af.wr_fee
    FROM addr_filtered AS af
    JOIN demo1 AS d1
      ON af.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = d1.cd1_sk
     AND af.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = d1.cd2_sk
    WHERE af.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
    UNION ALL
    SELECT af.wr_reason_sk, af.ws_quantity, af.wr_refunded_cash, af.wr_fee
    FROM addr_filtered AS af
    JOIN demo2 AS d2
      ON af.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = d2.cd1_sk
     AND af.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = d2.cd2_sk
    WHERE af.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
    UNION ALL
    SELECT af.wr_reason_sk, af.ws_quantity, af.wr_refunded_cash, af.wr_fee
    FROM addr_filtered AS af
    JOIN demo3 AS d3
      ON af.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk = d3.cd1_sk
     AND af.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = d3.cd2_sk
    WHERE af.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
)
SELECT
    substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(f.ws_quantity),
    avg(f.wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(f.wr_fee)
FROM filtered AS f
JOIN reason AS r
  ON r.r_reason_sk = f.wr_reason_sk
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY
    substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(f.ws_quantity),
    avg(f.wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(f.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
